rationale: Repair the published USER_ANSWER evidence-source seam so runtime lookup uses the existing coverage registry only for governed product resolution, then discovers immutable authoritative-publication/certified-evidence artifacts from the resolved product's governed publication directory. This replaces insurer/product/topic-specific Python branches and runtime builder reconstruction. The coverage-registry contracts and seed semantics, generic publication gate, publication-backed resolver, materializer, reasoning, decision, explanation, and orchestration algorithms remain unchanged. No new registry or insurance semantic capability is introduced.
supersession_impact: The Star-specific runtime source adapter is retired after room-rent and bariatric migration fixtures are persisted. Historical Star publication and certification builders remain available for tests/history but no longer participate in ordinary answer lookup. The existing Health coverage registry remains unchanged and continues to represent only the established copayment/waiting_period concept matrix.
authority_impact: No authority is expanded. Authoritative publication remains the admission authority. Frozen publication artifacts are discovered only after governed product resolution, and certified topics without authoritative-publication artifacts, including Star waiting_period/PED, continue to fail closed for USER_ANSWER use.
